doc: A wall network to build (design/planner.md, Walls, fences, and gates): its kind, its network, which chunk of it (or all), and the season.

fields.name: condition
fields.doc: Intact, or a ruin: broken down, roofless, overgrown, without its moving parts or lit fires.

fields.name: network
fields.doc: The network: its nodes, links, gates, and towers.

fields.name: chunk
fields.doc: Which chunk to build, 0 to chunks - 1.

fields.name: chunks
fields.doc: How many chunks to split it into (by angle round its middle; 0 or 1: all of it).
